capabilities: Route new notes to preset folders by typing a defined prefix
Trigger note creation from the editor by cursor inside wikilinks or selection
Bind commands per prefix to hotkeys and open notes in same tab, new tab, pane, or window
Prompt a folder suggester when no prefix matches or the input is escaped with a slash
Handle existing files by opening them or creating a numbered duplicate
extras: The README includes a demo video, notes mobile-specific styling fixes tested on iOS 16.4.1, and ends with the candid remark 'Newly introduced bugs to be fixed'.
problem: Obsidian's default note creation drops files in one default location, so filing a note into the right folder requires manual steps after creation.

relations.evidence: You can combine Rapid Notes with Templater plugin to speed up your workflow even further
the modules used for prompts and suggesters are based on Liam's Periodic Notes Plugin
SilentVoid13's Templater Plugin. All the credits go to the original authors

summary: Prefix-based note creator that places new notes into preset folders, with hotkey commands and in-editor creation from wikilinks.
